educationGuide.title: Prepare for school conversations one topic at a time.
educationGuide.description: Use these general educational starting points to organize questions for your school team. They are not a decision about a child or a school service.
educationGuide.disclaimer: Educational information only. School procedures and eligibility rules may vary by location and individual circumstances.

iepGuide.title: Reading an IEP with a question-first approach
iepGuide.description: An IEP may describe goals, services, supports, and how progress is shared. Use it to note what is clear, what needs an example, and what you want to ask the team.

eligibility.title: Understanding school-based eligibility
eligibility.description: School-based eligibility is a process used by a school system. Medical information may be useful context, but it does not by itself answer every school-planning question.

evaluation.title: Preparing for a school evaluation
evaluation.description: Write down strengths, situations that are going well, concerns, and questions. Ask the school team what information they will consider and how results will be discussed.

accommodations.title: Accommodations and modifications
accommodations.description: An accommodation generally changes how a student accesses learning, while a modification can change what learning is expected. Terms and practices can vary, so ask the school team how support is planned.

meetingNotes.title: Preparing meeting notes and questions
meetingNotes.description: Bring a short list of strengths, concerns, questions, decisions, and follow-up items. After the meeting, note who will do what and when you plan to check in.

autismSupport.title: Supporting an autistic student at school
autismSupport.description: A student’s needs and strengths are individual. Families can ask the school team about communication, routines, sensory needs, participation, and the supports already working well.

educationGuide.nextStepTitle: Keep your planning private and organized.
educationGuide.nextStepDescription: Create a family workspace when you are ready to organize questions and documents. More planning tools are still in development.

privacy.title: Sensitive information deserves careful boundaries.
privacy.description: Ethiospectrum is being designed around private storage, server-side authorization, auditability, and minimal data use. This is an architecture commitment, not a compliance claim.

publicServices.title: Support for your family, in your language
publicServices.independentNotice: Consultation and IEP Language Assistance can be purchased on their own — no RBT Boot Camp subscription required.

rbt.name: RBT Boot Camp
rbt.description: A self-paced video library that helps parents understand neurodivergency, complete our curriculum, and prepare for an external RBT-related credential or exam.
features: Progress tracking for you and your child

consultation.name: Consultation
consultation.description: General household and service guidance, or specific behavioral and educational guidance, with a matched specialist.

iep.name: IEP Language Assistance
iep.description: Understand your child's IEP, get language assistance at school meetings, and receive a written translation.
features: Remote or in person, no travel fee
Written translation and one follow-up included

policy: More than 48 hours before: 100% refund, or reschedule at no charge.
24 to 48 hours before: 50% refund, or reschedule once at no charge.
Less than 24 hours before: reschedule once without paying again; no cash refund unless an administrator approves an exception.
No-show: no automatic refund; rescheduling may be approved case by case.
If Ethiospectrum cancels, you receive a 100% refund or may reschedule.
fees: Applicable taxes are calculated at checkout where required.
No travel fee is charged for in-person IEP assistance.
Any additional fee is shown for your approval before you pay.
publicServices.certificationDisclaimer: Completing RBT Boot Camp is not an RBT certification. Ethiospectrum is not an accredited RBT credential provider.
publicServices.languageTitle: Services in English, Amharic, and Spanish
publicServices.languageDescription: Specialists are matched by the service, language, and delivery method your family needs.
languageItems: IEP explanation and school-meeting language assistance
Remote sessions or in person at Ethiospectrum, the school, or an agreed location
